verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents a time off request API covering the full lifecycle, from balance checking and submission through admin approval and payroll integration. It also offers an embedded approval flow (time_off_request_management) plus approve/decline endpoints. The evidence never shows an ops user defining PTO policies or configuring accrual rules, so only the approval and payroll-integration halves of the story are documented. Missing for 10: documented PTO policy creation, accrual configuration, evidence that approved time off flows automatically into payroll runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
